verdict.rationale: Otter documents scheduling its notetaker to auto-join Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings (otter-docs-17). It also offers bot-free recording from the Mac/Windows desktop app and for impromptu Google Meet calls, plus mobile recording, which gives choice over how and where capture happens. A community user records all their work meetings with it and finds it reliable. However, hands-on reports describe the bot joining meetings unexpectedly and rejoining after a user tried to stop it, which undercuts the 'recording where I want it' control. Missing for 10: documented per-meeting recording controls, independent evidence of reliable Teams and Zoom capture, and a resolution of the reports of unwanted auto-join and rejoin behavior.
